protocol.description:
This protocol extends ext_image_capture_source_v1 with a source type for workspaces represented by ext_workspace_handle_v1 objects.
It only creates image capture source objects. Capturing images from these sources requires a separate protocol, such as ext_image_copy_capture_v1.

interface.name: ext_workspace_image_capture_source_v1

description.summary: image capture source manager for workspaces

interface.description: A manager for creating image capture source objects for ext_workspace_handle_v1 objects.

request.name: create_source
request.description:
Creates an image capture source for the workspace represented by workspace_handle.
Captured images must represent the workspace as if it were active in its workspace group, even when it is inactive or not visible to the user. Creating or capturing this source must not activate the workspace or otherwise change which workspace is displayed to the user.
The source represents the composited view of the workspace, rather than a collection of images of individual windows. Windows may occlude one another. The compositor may omit content according to its capture policy, including protected content, panels, docks, desktop backgrounds, and overlays. Cursor capture is governed by the protocol used to capture images from the source.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the workspace image capture source. This request may be sent at any time by the client.
